structure: A Confluence-hosted architecture Decision Record (DR-EUDP-005, status Proposed, auto-generated from a GitHub markdown source). Layout: an info panel and a TOC macro, then H1 title, a 6-row metadata table, then Context, Decision (with the boundary rule, the test tiers table and tier 4 in detail) and Consequences.

claims.statement: The date the DR was agreed on is not yet recorded.
The boundary rule verbatim: inside the INS product boundary, run the real component; outside it, run a stub configured from the agreed interface SLA.
claims.quote:
Inside the INS product boundary  ->  run the real component
Outside the INS product boundary ->  run a stub configured from the agreed interface SLA

claims.statement: Tier 1 (Component): runs one frontend or backend with all dependencies stubbed, on every pull request at smoke scale, to answer whether this change made it slower.
claims.quote: Did this change make it slower

claims.statement: What tier 4 is explicitly not: not a load test (tens of requests, not hundreds a second); does not prove the dependency can carry INS at peak; not a functional test.
claims.quote: What tier 4 is not: it is not a load test, since it sends tens of requests rather than hundreds a second, which is what makes it something an owner will agree to.
